notes.title: 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
**v2.0 Release Update!**

This update is huge! from massive graphical differences and performance upgrades to remastered levels.
This update has most of it!
The update includes:
* Level Remasters
* Movement Changes
* Huge Graphics Updates (Added SSR, Path Tracing, SSGI, Realtime GI, Volumetrics and Volumetric Clouds and more)
* Big Bug Fixes (Fixed Level 6, Level 15, Level 7, Level 8, Level 9.)
* Level Changes (On mentioned levels above)
* Remastered Main Menu
* **Added Checkpoints! Woohoo!**
* Added DirectX12 Support (no way to access yet.)
* Fixed Steam Achievements
* Added Secret Achievement
* Added new Post-Processing Effects (make it look better haha)
* Script Optimization
* Water Improvements
* Added Decals
* Added Audio Reverb
* Updated Swimming / Climbing Systems
* Updated Camera
* Updated Credits
**And yes, there is more.**

Oh, by the way, mid 2025. LocoMotion: The Revival

notes.title: Some News About LocoMotion
notes.content:
So, the Short Answer is: I was burnt out. 
I didn't have the motivation as the game didn't do as well as it deserved. 

Until Today!
I will continue to update the game for as long as I can! Releasing Updates and bug Fixes!

[b]The Current List of Known Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] On level 6+ if you press z, it will skip the current level, putting you on the next one.
[*] Strange water colliders on level 3
[*] Visual bug: Swinging balls are pumpkins.
[*] Swinging Balls do not ragdoll you.
Please Comment on this post about any bugs you have! I will try to fix as many as possible and it will help make the game a much more polished game!
[/list]

[h2][b][u]UPDATE IN A DAY OR TWO![/u][/b][/h2]

[i]Posted By Dylan (Laym Studios)[/i]

notes.title: LocoMotion Multiplayer Is coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Yes! Youve heard that right! We are making LocoMotion Multiplayer![/b][/u][/h1]
[h2]A few features you should expect from the Multiplayer Update:[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Realtime Updates
[*]New Steam Networking
[*]Join Lobbys from an id or from an invite.
[*]Synced animations and positions.
[*]A Lobby Browser
[*]A new menu for Multiplayer, Create options, join options.
[*]Fast, Smooth and Asynchronous client prediction using Mirror.
[*]4 Lobby Slots
[*]A new map exclusively for Multiplayer.
[/olist]
[h2]And More!![/h2]

If you would like to try out Multiplayer in BETA then
Right click on LocoMotion in your Library and click properties, then click betas, put in the code: locomotionbeta EXACTLY How it is spelt.

Enjoy the news!!
